title: Süper İşler Takımı Yemek Yapıyor
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: Super Grandma is retiring, and the best gift would be a table set with her secret recipes. But reaching the recipe notebook is not easy. Red Dino and Whirling Storm must embark on an adventure full of traps. Can the Super Team reach the notebook and prepare the perfect surprise?
